Review:

I had a really good experience with this EV charging station. What impressed me the most was that the charging started instantly without wasting even a minute. Unlike many other Tata Power chargers where there is often a delay in connecting or initiating the session, this one worked seamlessly and efficiently from the very beginning.

Another major advantage is the setup of the charging station itself. It is quite spacious, which makes maneuvering and parking the vehicle very convenient. There is enough room around the charging bays, so it doesn’t feel cramped even when multiple vehicles are present.

I also appreciated that the charging station is covered. This may seem like a small detail, but it makes a huge difference, especially during harsh weather conditions like Mumbai’s heat or monsoon rains. Being able to plug in and wait comfortably without worrying about direct sunlight or getting drenched is a big plus.

Overall, this charging station offers a smooth, hassle-free, and user-friendly charging experience. The instant charging initiation, spacious layout, and covered infrastructure make it stand out from many other charging points. I would definitely prefer using this station again and highly recommend it to fellow EV owners.
